scoring_justification: The equilibrium node angles are a deterministic output of a complex anisotropic elasticity computation that cannot be recomputed cheaply in the verifier sandbox; comparing the agent-reported angles against paper gold with tolerance is appropriate (non-directional fixed quantity).

hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text Section 3.3 isolated node angle 86 +/- 0.5 deg; Section 3.4 network node angle 91.6 +/- 0.5 deg
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from the paper's reported values and validated against the reference solve.sh output
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values exactly match the paper's stated numerical results for the symmetric three-fold node in bcc iron.

outputs.description: Equilibrium node angles (2α) for the symmetric three-fold node in α-iron. Isolated angle from semi-infinite dislocation rays; network angle including finite segment interactions.
